option_relations.rationale: Severe COVID-19 pneumonia with ARDS in pregnancy requiring V-V ECMO support is a specific, severe presentation of COVID-19.

Community-acquired pneumonia is a broad category of pneumonia, but the vignette strongly points to COVID-19 as the specific cause, making this option less precise and potentially misleading without further specification.
Acute viral pneumonia (non-COVID) explicitly excludes COVID-19, which is the primary diagnosis indicated by the vignette.
COVID-19 pneumonia with respiratory failure is a specific manifestation of COVID-19.
